_readme: Descriptions for translators, written by po_context.py as '#. Description: ...' in tero.pot and tero.*.po. Key: the '#:' identifier of the entry (lower case). Write in English, one or two short sentences: what the feature does, not where it is (the script adds that). Keys starting with '_' are ignored.
tfrmmain.actpastetexts.caption: Pastes only the texts copied from other entries into the selected entries, keeping their timings and translations.
tfrmmain.actpastetimes.caption: Pastes only the timings copied from other entries into the selected entries, keeping their texts.
tfrmmain.actpastetranslations.caption: Pastes the translations copied from other entries into the translation column of the selected entries.
tfrmmain.actpasteastranslations.caption: Pastes the texts (original column) copied from other entries into the translation column of the selected entries. Useful to bring a translation from another file.
tfrmmain.actextendstarttoshotchange.capt: Moves the start of the selected entries back to the previous shot change (scene cut), following the cue settings. Disabled when there are no shot changes.
tfrmmain.actextendendtoshotchange.captio: Moves the end of the selected entries forward to the next shot change (scene cut), following the cue settings. Disabled when there are no shot changes.
tfrmmain.actextendlengthtoprevious.capti: Moves the start time of the selected entries back until it touches the end of the previous entry (minus the minimum gap).
tfrmmain.actextendlengthtonext.caption: Moves the end time of the selected entries forward until it touches the start of the next entry (minus the minimum gap).
tfrmmain.actmediaautoscroll.caption: On/off option: while the media plays, the subtitle list scrolls and selects the entry being shown.
tfrmmain.actsourcemode.caption: View mode that shows the subtitle file as plain text, to edit its source directly.
tfrmmain.actlistmode.caption: View mode with the list of entries (the normal editing mode).
tfrmmain.acttranscriptionmode.caption: View mode with a free text area to transcribe the audio while the media plays.
tfrmmain.acttranslatormode.caption: On/off option: shows a second text column for the translation next to the original text.
tfrmmain.acttimeline.caption: On/off option: shows the waveform/timeline under the video, where entries can be created and moved with the mouse.
tfrmmain.actframesmode.caption: Shows and edits the times as frames (timecode HH:MM:SS:FF) instead of milliseconds.
tfrmmain.acttimemode.caption: Shows and edits the times in milliseconds (HH:MM:SS.ZZZ) instead of frames.
tfrmmain.actsetgapping.caption: Opens a window to set the gap (pause) between consecutive entries.
tfrmmain.actsetdefaultgap.caption: Applies the default minimum gap (from the settings) between the selected entries and the next ones.
tfrmmain.actsetautomaticduration.caption: Recalculates the end time of the selected entries from the length of their text.
tfrmmain.actmediastartsubtitleentry.capt: While the media plays, marks the current position as the start of a new entry (used together with End entry).
tfrmmain.actmediaendsubtitleentry.captio: While the media plays, marks the current position as the end and creates the entry started with Start entry.
tfrmmain.actmediaaddentry.caption: Creates a new entry at the cursor or at the selection of the waveform/timeline.
tfrmmain.actmediadeleteentry.caption: Deletes the entry selected on the waveform/timeline.
tfrmmain.actmediamovesubtitleentry.capti: Moves the selected entries so that they start at the current position of the media.
tfrmmain.actmediasetinitialtime.caption: Sets the start time of the selected entries to the current position of the media.
tfrmmain.actmediasetfinaltime.caption: Sets the end time of the selected entries to the current position of the media.
tfrmmain.actmediazoomselection.caption: Zooms the waveform to fit the selected range.
tfrmmain.actcenterwaveform.caption: On/off option: keeps the play cursor in the middle of the waveform while playing.
tfrmmain.actviewshotchange.caption: On/off option: shows or hides the shot change (scene cut) marks on the waveform.
tfrmmain.actswaptexts.caption: Exchanges the text and the translation of the selected entries.
tfrmmain.actdivideentry.caption: Splits each selected entry that is too long into several entries, dividing its time between them.
tfrmmain.actcombineentries.caption: Joins the selected entries into one entry with all their texts.
tfrmmain.actunbreakentry.caption: Joins the lines of the selected entries into one line.
tfrmmain.actautobreakentry.caption: Breaks the text of the selected entries into lines automatically, following the maximum characters per line.
tfrmmain.actfixrtlpunctuation.caption: For right-to-left languages (Arabic, Hebrew...): moves the punctuation that appears at the wrong side of the line.
tfrmmain.actpanandscan.caption: On/off option: video zoom that fills the window, cropping the sides of the image.
tfrmmain.acttm1.caption: Copies the first suggestion of the translation memory into the translation. 'tm' = translation memory.
tfrmmain.acttm2.caption: Copies the second suggestion of the translation memory into the translation. 'tm' = translation memory.
tfrmmain.acttm3.caption: Copies the third suggestion of the translation memory into the translation. 'tm' = translation memory.
tfrmmain.actvalidatetm.caption: Adds the current text and its translation to the translation memory, then goes to the next entry.
tfrmmain.actwebreference.caption: Searches the selected word (or the word under the cursor) on the web site set in the settings.
tfrmmain.actinsertcurrenttime.caption: In transcription mode, inserts the current media time into the text, like (00:01:23.456).
tfrmmain.actshifttimemore.caption: Moves the selected entries later by the number of milliseconds set in the settings. %d is that number.
tfrmmain.actshifttimeless.caption: Moves the selected entries earlier by the number of milliseconds set in the settings. %d is that number.
tfrmmain.actshowcolumnnumber.caption: Shows or hides the column with the entry number and the gap to the previous entry.
tfrmmain.actreadtimingsfromfile.caption: Takes the timings from another subtitle file and applies them to the current entries, keeping the texts.
tfrmmain.actreadtextsfromfile.caption: Takes the texts from another subtitle file and applies them to the current entries, keeping the timings.
tfrmmain.actfontclear.caption: Removes all formatting tags (bold, italic, color...) from the text.
tfrmmain.actsaveproject.caption: Saves a project file that remembers the subtitle, translation, media and settings of this work.
proclocalize.lngroundtimesonload: Question shown after opening a file with timings in milliseconds that do not fall on video frames. %1:s is the frame rate (fps), %0:d the number of entries affected.
proclocalize.lngfsetchaining: Fix subtitles option: joins entries separated by a very small gap so that one starts right where the previous one ends.
proclocalize.lngfsetsnaptoshotchanges: Fix subtitles option: moves the start and end of entries that are near a shot change (scene cut) onto it.
proclocalize.lngscedit: Name of a shortcut category in Settings > Shortcuts (the Edit menu commands).
proclocalize.lngscfile: Name of a shortcut category in Settings > Shortcuts (the File menu commands).
